source_title: Serco Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 100 and 153 state that the relevant reports were approved by the Board of Directors on 25 February 2020; document identity and year match the official Serco report record.
observation: Revenue increased 15% to £3,248m, underlying trading profit 29% to £120.2m, margin from 3.3% to 3.7% and free cash flow from £16.3m to £62.0m. The order book increased from £12.0bn to £14.1bn and adjusted net debt of £215m left leverage at the lower end of the 1-2x target range. Management described the five-year transformation as substantially concluded and the business as entering growth.
already_announced_exclusion: The Stabilise and Transform programme, corporate renewal, prior disposals and loss-contract remediation, and the NSBU acquisition disclosed or completed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Broad revenue, profit, margin, cash-flow and order-book growth, with comfortable leverage and the turnaround declared complete, provide strong quantified evidence against restructuring pressure.

source_title: Serco Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 116, 172 and 179 state that the relevant reports were approved by the Board of Directors on 23 February 2022; document identity and year match the official Serco report record.
observation: Revenue increased 14% to £4,425m, underlying trading profit 40% to £229m, margin from 4.2% to 5.2% and free cash flow from £135m to £190m. All regions improved margins by about 90bps or more. Adjusted net debt rose from £58m to £178m because acquisitions, dividends and share repurchases exceeded free cash generation, but remained supported by strong cash conversion and no working-capital financing.
already_announced_exclusion: Completed acquisitions and integrations, the Dubai Metro contract exit and legacy transformation and remediation activity disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Strong organic growth, sharply higher profit and margins, £190m free cash flow and 112% profit cash conversion substantially outweigh acquisition-driven higher debt.

source_title: Serco Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report page 93 states that the Strategic Report was approved by the Board of Directors on 1 March 2024; document identity and year match the official Serco report record.
observation: Revenue increased 7% to £4,874m, underlying operating profit 5% to £249m, reported operating profit 25% and diluted underlying EPS 10%. Group margin was broadly stable at 5.1% versus 5.2%; free cash flow increased 31% to £209m, adjusted net debt fell 47% to £109m and reported net debt fell 13%. Organic defence and immigration growth more than replaced concluded COVID work.
already_announced_exclusion: The ORS acquisition and integration, concluded COVID-related work, previously announced contract exits and historic disposal-provision releases are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Organic and reported revenue growth, higher profit, stable margin, materially stronger free cash flow and major deleveraging provide multiple strong quantified offsets and no substantive restructuring signal.
